iodide is shown.
H2(g)  +  I2(g)
energy

Four statements about this reaction are listed.
1
The reaction is exothermic.
2
The reaction is endothermic.
3
The temperature of the mixture increases during the reaction.
4
The temperature of the mixture decreases during the reaction.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
